concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: Which of following organisations sought to revive Vedic learning and combine it with modern education in the sciences?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arya Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arya Samaj** was a Hindu reform movement founded by **Swami Dayananda Saraswati** in **1875**.
 
• Its primary aim was to revive the **Vedic traditions** and promote the teachings of the **Vedas** as the ultimate authority in all spheres of life.
 
• The organization sought to integrate **ancient Vedic knowledge** with **modern education in the sciences** to ensure the progress of society.
 
• The Arya Samaj emphasized the importance of **education** and established several **schools and colleges** such as the **Dayanand Anglo-Vedic (DAV) institutions** to impart a blend of Vedic and modern knowledge.
 
• The movement opposed **idolatry, superstitions, and caste-based discrimination**, advocating for social reforms such as **women’s education, widow remarriage, and the abolition of child marriage.**
 
• It also promoted the concept of **Swadeshi** (self-reliance) and contributed to the **Indian independence movement.**
 
• The Arya Samaj’s teachings are rooted in the principles of **truth, universal brotherhood, and the upliftment of society.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj**__

 __
 
• The **Satyashodhak Samaj** was founded by **Jyotirao Phule** in **1873** in Maharashtra.
 
• It aimed to fight against **social injustice** and the domination of the **Brahminical caste system.**
 
• The organization worked for the **upliftment of oppressed classes**, including the **Dalits** and **women.**
 
• It did not focus on integrating Vedic learning with modern education but rather on creating awareness about **equality and social reforms.**
 
 
 
• **Brahmo Samaj**__
 __
 
• The **Brahmo Samaj** was founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** in **1828**.
 
• This movement aimed at **monotheism** and opposed **ritualism, idol worship, and caste discrimination.**
 
• It focused on **social and religious reforms**, such as the abolition of **Sati** and the promotion of **women's rights**, rather than the revival of Vedic learning.
 
 
 
• **Prarthana Samaj**__
 
 
• The **Prarthana Samaj** was established in **1867** in Bombay by **Atmaram Pandurang** and later supported by **M.G. Ranade**.
 
• It was a reformist movement emphasizing **monotheism** and opposing **superstitions and caste discrimination.**
 
• Unlike the Arya Samaj, it did not focus on reviving Vedic learning but concentrated on **ethical living and social reforms** such as **widow remarriage** and **women's education.**
